## About
We are a retail nursery in Helotes that specializes in seed grown native Texas trees. You can always find Monterrey oaks, live oaks, cedar elms, Mexican sycamores, Texas red buds and more, in sizes up to large and extra large mature trees.
Beyond the trees, we carry shrubs for privacy and screening, deer resistant choices, perennials, annuals, vines and succulents. There is also an onsite florist for arrangements, weddings and deliveries.
If you need more than a plant, we do landscape design and installation, including xeriscape work. One reviewer wrote that owner Sherry came to her house, showed her plant pictures and made a virtual design so she and her husband could see it before anything went in the ground.

## Services
- Native Texas trees: Seed grown native trees for south central Texas, from oaks and cedar elms to Mexican sycamores and Texas red buds, in multiple sizes.
- Shrubs and perennials: Privacy and screening shrubs, flowering shrubs, perennials, annuals, vines and succulents suited to Texas yards.
- Planting services: Buy your plants here and we can plant them for you, any time of year.
- Design and installation: Landscape design, installation, lighting and xeriscape work for your yard.
- Floral arrangements: Fresh and silk arrangements, wedding flowers and deliveries.

## FAQ
Q: When is the best time to come in for trees?
A: We keep the nursery stocked year round, but spring, early summer and early fall are usually the best times to shop for trees.

Q: How can I check what you have in stock?
A: Our Google page, Wilson Landscape and Tree Nursery, has updates on current stock. You can also email us or give us a call.

Q: Are you ever closed during regular hours?
A: We close for major holidays and bad weather. Please check our Google page or call before traveling far to visit.
